newsitem.title: UK: Gefco adds 50,000 sq ft to Midland freight hub.
newsitem.headline: Gefco adds 50,000 sq ft to Midland freight hub.

text.p: Gefco said it has completed a 50,000 sq ft extension to its Midland regional freight terminal at Coventry.

The two million pound development takes overall space at Coventry to 83,OOO sq ft employing 80 staff for Gefco's domestic and international distribution and automotive activities, it added in a statement.

"The Coventry terminal is very important in Gefco UK's operations as it is the central hub in the national distribution network for our added value freight and logistics services, as well as being important to our automotive sector activities," said Russell Green, Gefco's Coventry regional manager.
"The new extension is very welcome as extra space was urgently needed to handle an increasing volume of business across both areas."
Of the 83,000 sq ft dual-warehouse facility, 33,OOO sq ft comprises a 22-pier warehouse which is devoted to Gefco's national and international groupage cross-docking operations.

The new 50,OOO sq ft extension provides space for contract distribution customers including room for automotive components storage. Both the groupage and automotive businesses operate 24 hours a day, five days a week. On average some 50 vehicles a day use the hub.
Gefco's hub is sited next to Coventry Air Park enabling customers to move goods by air if necessary.
Gefco is the forwarding unit of French automobile group, Peugeot-Citroen. -- Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
